The '''Im'g'twe Hills''' were an elevated region on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] located near the [[Badlands of N'g'zi]].<ref name="Galactic Defense" /> The area was home to the [[Petranaki Arena]], several [[droid]] [[Factory|factories]] and the [[Separatist command center]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] used the wide and flat plains between the elevated areas as landing zones for Separatist [[starship]]s.<ref name="Rise" /> After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists']] failed [[Death penalty|execution]] of [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker]] in the Petranaki arena, a portion of the subsequent [[First Battle of Geonosis|battle]] occurred in the Im'g'twe Hills.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> After the battle and subsequent skirmishes, the Im'g'twe Hills were littered with Separatist and [[Galactic Republic]] debris.<ref name="Rise" />
